comparison.objective: Hook and snap a module onto a DIN rail; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hook-pivot insertion and spring-latch engagement versus screw adjustment and jam-nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Module square, latched behind both rail lips, and still versus accurate opening retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: Snap-fit installation is a different tested ability from adjustable-stop locking.
